turns.q: Where can I find your full shipping policy?
turns.replyTail:
You can find our full shipping policy here: https://saigucosmetics.com/pages/politica-de-envios-y-devoluciones

We also ship within the EU through our local sites, and we do not currently ship to the Canary Islands, Ceuta, or Melilla.
